items.name: Bouncing Logo
items.blurb: The Shell:B tile drifts across a starry black, changes colour on every wall and flashes when it hits a corner. You know the one.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Harmonograph
items.blurb: A pen on damped pendulums draws Lissajous roses on dark paper, one figure fading into the next. Every figure is new; the ink changes with the hour.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Ink Currents
items.blurb: Thousands of ink particles ride a slowly turning flow field, leaving trails that fade like ink in water. The current and the palette shift over minutes.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Koi Pond
items.blurb: A slow koi pond at night seen from above: koi glide and turn in schools, ripples spread where they surface, lily pads drift, moonlight shimmers on the water.
items.author: Evie & Shell:B

items.name: Starfield Warp
items.blurb: Nine hundred stars streak past in white, cyan, pink and violet while the vanishing point drifts. Shell:B's built-in warp.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Synthwave Horizon
items.blurb: A striped sun sinks toward a neon grid that scrolls toward you under a starry violet sky. Shell:B's original screensaver.
items.author: Shell:B
